# Grafana Assistant

Skills that teach agents to work with Grafana Assistant. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [grafana/ai-marketplace](https://github.com/grafana/ai-marketplace), at commit `12be563`.

Skills and rules for developing and using the Grafana Assistant app and CLI.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Grafana Assistant**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Grafana Assistant**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install grafana-assistant@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `grafana-assistant-cli`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/grafana/ai-marketplace
